maps.name: Oban and Lorn
maps.blurb: Oban Bay, Kerrera and its sound, Dunstaffnage and the Falls of Lora: 12 km of Argyll coast at full scale.

maps.name: The Firth of Clyde
maps.blurb: Bute and Rothesay, the Kyles and Loch Striven, Dunoon and the Holy Loch, Gourock, Greenock and Helensburgh, Largs and the Cumbraes: 35 by 37 km at full scale.

maps.name: Syros
maps.blurb: The whole island in the Cyclades: Ermoupoli and its harbour under Ano Syros, Foinikas and Posidonia, Kini, Vari and the islets off the east coast: 15 by 19 km at full scale.

maps.name: Turku and the Archipelago Sea
maps.blurb: Turku and its port, the Meyer Turku yard at Perno, Ruissalo, the Airisto fairway, Pargas, Nagu and the islands between: 37 by 38 km at full scale.

maps.name: The Port of Hamburg
maps.blurb: The Elbe from Finkenwerder and Övelgönne to the Elbe bridges: the Landungsbrücken, the Speicherstadt and HafenCity, the container terminals and the Köhlbrand: 14 by 8 km at full scale.

maps.name: The Saronic Islands
maps.blurb: Aegina, Agistri, Methana, Poros, Hydra and Spetses, and the Argolid coast from Korfos and Epidavros to Ermioni and Porto Heli: 44 by 74 km at full scale.

maps.name: Ålesund and Sunnmøre
maps.blurb: Ålesund on its islands, Ellingsøya, Valderøya, Vigra and Godøya, Sula, Hareid and Ulsteinvik, Gurskøya and Herøy, the Vartdalsfjorden and the Storfjorden to Ørsta: 55 by 52 km at full scale.

maps.name: Tayvallich and Loch Sween
maps.blurb: Tayvallich and its bay, Caol Scotnish and the Fairy Isles, Loch Sween to Achnamara, and the Sound of Jura shore: 11 by 16 km at full scale.
